items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Yeah, I worked off and on with Joe many times with the band... So I can in all honesty say Joe Williams was my best man when I got married.

ctx.x: Interesting. What — have you ever been on a gig when Joe Williams was a guest vocalist?

Oh, yeah, many times, many times. He’s wonderful to work with also. As a matter of fact there’s another bit of Basie memorabilia is that when I was in the band, the lady who was going to be and is now my wife, she and I decided that we were going to get married in Las Vegas because we were going in to play a stint with Tony Bennett at the Sahara Hotel for one or two weeks. And we all agreed. And her father passed away when she was quite young, and so one of the closest friends we had was Basie, and so she asked…
Who were some of your favorite arrangers for the Basie group?
